listQuery: SELECT 'project'::text AS entity_kind, 'project:' || id::text AS external_key, name::text AS name, severity::text AS severity, updated_at::text AS updated_at FROM projects UNION ALL SELECT 'component'::text, 'component:' || id::text, name::text, severity::text, updated_at::text FROM components UNION ALL SELECT 'sscs'::text, 'sscs:' || id::text, name::text, severity::text, updated_at::text FROM sscs
detailQuery: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'project'::text AS entity_kind, 'project:' || id::text AS external_key, name::text AS name, severity::text AS severity, updated_at::text AS updated_at FROM projects UNION ALL SELECT 'component'::text, 'component:' || id::text, name::text, severity::text, updated_at::text FROM components UNION ALL SELECT 'sscs'::text, 'sscs:' || id::text, name::text, severity::text, updated_at::text FROM sscs) AS combined WHERE external_key = $1
